Entropy-based segmentation by (stochastic) EM (R6)

Source: R/segmentation.R
EntropySegmenter.Rd

Unsupervised segmentation of SAR/PolSAR images from maps of estimated Shannon entropies (Ferreira and Nascimento, 2020; Nascimento, Ferreira and Frery, 2023). By the asymptotic normality of the entropy estimators, the entropy vector of a pixel of the \(g\)-th region is approximately Gaussian, so the image is modelled as a finite mixture of Gaussian laws (with diagonal covariance matrices) fitted by the expectation-maximisation algorithm (method = "em") or by its stochastic version (method = "sem"), in which the E-step is followed by a random allocation of every pixel to a class drawn from its posterior probabilities. Pixels are then labelled by the maximum a posteriori rule.

References

Ferreira, J. A. and Nascimento, A. D. C. (2020). Shannon entropy for the G0I model: a new segmentation approach. IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing, 13, 2547–2553. doi:10.1109/JSTARS.2020.2997666

Nascimento, A. D. C., Ferreira, J. A. and Frery, A. C. (2023). Unsupervised segmentation of PolSAR data with complex Wishart and G0m distributions and Shannon entropy. Statistics and Computing, 33, 129. doi:10.1007/s11222-023-10298-0

Public fields

k

Number of classes.

method

"em" or "sem".

weights

Mixture weights.

means

Matrix (k x features) of class means.

variances

Matrix (k x features) of class variances.

posterior

Matrix of posterior probabilities.

labels

Integer vector of labels (classes ordered by the mean of the first feature).

loglik

Trace of the log-likelihood.

iterations

Number of iterations.

converged

Logical convergence flag.

dim

Spatial dimensions when fitted to a map (NULL otherwise).

EntropySegmenter$fit()

Fit the mixture.

Usage

EntropySegmenter$fit(x, init = NULL, is_map = TRUE)

Arguments

x

Entropy features: a matrix (one map, or pixels in rows and features in columns when is_map = FALSE), an array nrow x ncol x features (several maps), or a numeric vector.

init

Initial labels (integer vector) or NULL for k-means.

is_map

Treat a matrix x as a single map? Default TRUE.

Examples

H <- entropy_map(SanFrancisco150, model = "wishart", window = 7, L = 4)
set.seed(1)
seg <- EntropySegmenter$new(k = 3)$fit(H)
seg
#> <EntropySegmenter> k = 3 | method: EM 
#>   iterations: 20 | converged: TRUE 
#>   weights: 0.265 0.268 0.467 
#>   class sizes: 5933 5773 10794 
plot_map(seg$label_map(), main = "Entropy-based segmentation")

kappa_statistics(SanFrancisco150_gt, seg$label_map())
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   kappa   variance std_error overall_accuracy     n
#>   <dbl>      <dbl>     <dbl>            <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 0.914 0.00000566   0.00238            0.945 22500
